summary: Find Red Hat execution environments in the Red Hat Ecosystem Catalog, log in to registry.redhat.io (inside the devcontainer if dev tools run in a container), and pull one, e.g. podman pull registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-26/ee-minimal-rhel9; customise with ansible-builder and push to automation hub.
questions: How do I download a Red Hat execution environment image?
Where do I log in to registry.redhat.io when using a devcontainer?
What is the image name of the minimal AAP 2.6 execution environment?
How do I pull ee-minimal-rhel9 with podman?

answer_card.title: Pull a Red Hat execution environment
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
podman login registry.redhat.io
podman pull registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-26/ee-minimal-rhel9
```
If Ansible development tools run in a VS Code devcontainer, run the login from a terminal inside that devcontainer. Browse other images in the Red Hat Ecosystem Catalog, build custom ones with `ansible-builder`, and push them to automation hub.
